name: eval
description: Swarmail's eval recipe, interim path (decision 0119, recording the operator's 2026-10-18 rulings on #148): one exec trial seat that runs the opaque eval-trial driver (swarmail-evals trial, which starts Swarmail and the fixture as its own children), then one exec scoring gate, which is the recipe's protected review (the engine requires a review phase in every bundle, brokkr 0.12.0 layer 1): it re-applies the task's check to the app's retained state and never reads the agent's account. Results are recorded as unconfined. No retries: a retried trial is a different experiment. The trial seat carries F5's read-only binds (the operator's 2026-11-24 ruling on #404, which approved this file by name for them alone): the four DNS inputs, the CLI and driver install trees, each family's source config and auth, the operator's selection directory, and dsh's profiles as an overlay. A paid recipe wrapper re-proves every declared read-only source, resolved against the seat's HOME, and the private profiles overlay in its own mount table before any credential read and refuses without them; the oracle and null controls need none of them. It moves to the MCP broker when brokkr#766 lands.
